messages:
Marta: Quick heads-up — ACME renewal hits in 9 days. They want to move to a 9-month term (instead of renewing 12) + request a 10% seat discount. Procurement also wants a single PO and one invoice. Can legal/finance weigh in?
Raj: Got it. Can we do a prorated 9-month price and apply the 10% seat discount as a one-time concession? I'll own the commercial note.
Oliver: Finance here — we can accept a 9-month term if the quote clearly shows proration and payment terms. Need invoice email and PO number to proceed. Net terms?
Marta: Buyer asked for net45. Quote link: https://redwood.internal/quotes/QU-2026-489 (placeholder). PO referenced in email: `ACME-2026-7890`.
Karen: If we shorten to 9 months we need an amendment reflecting term and renewal cadence. Also confirm auto-renew behavior — do they want auto-renew disabled?
Raj: They're ok with auto-renew but want initial term = 9 months. We'll keep auto-renew ON unless buyer objects in writing.
Ben: For enablement — they'd like 2 enablement workshops as part of the renewal. I can tentatively schedule two 90-min sessions w/ customer success engineers.
Marta: I've created a DocuSign envelope and sent to procurement contact. `esign-bot` created link.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope created by Marta — https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123 (sent to procurement@acme.com).
Oliver: Billing email to use? Also confirm net45 acceptance from finance side.
Marta: Billing email is `billing@acme-pay.com` and cc `finance@acme.com`. Procurement replied they will only sign if net45 is accepted.
Oliver: We can accept net45 for this strategic account once PO is received and credit check is green. Please attach PO to the order.
Karen: I'll draft the amendment with 9-month term, auto-renew clause left as-is, and explicit net45 payment term. Marking as legal-approved conditional on PO.
Raj: I'll update the quote today (9% prorate line + 10% seat discount) and send to the buyer. Aiming for e-sign by EOD Friday.
Marta: Procurement asked for a single invoice covering the entire 9 months. We should confirm if they prefer upfront invoice vs. monthly.
Oliver: Single upfront invoice is fine if they want it; otherwise we'll invoice per agreed cadence. If they pick single invoice, include `Invoice: QU-2026-489` on the PO.
Ben: Tentatively blocked two enablement slots next week — will keep them reserved until signing.
deploy-bot: renewal-reminder: ACME renewal - 9 days remaining — thread pinned to #customer-success for visibility.
Marta: Update: PO scanned and uploaded — `ACME-2026-7890` received at 18:12. Sending to finance to generate invoice. Thanks everyone. :tada:
